en: \[VSCode] Changed the extension to start Claude Code sessions with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` set while VS Code's telemetry setting is off, so they send no usage metrics or error reports and fetch no feature flags
zh: \[VSCode] 变更扩展，在 VS Code 遥测设置关闭时以设置 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 的方式启动 Claude Code session，使其不发送用量指标或错误报告，也不获取功能标志
